bug_summary: plpgsqlのEXCEPTIONブロックがサブトランザクション後にCurrentResourceOwnerを元(ポータルのオーナー)に戻しておらず、後続のリレーション参照解放が誤ったオーナーに対して行われクラッシュ+リカバリ突入していた
pr_title: Remove manual resource-owner snapshot/restore around plpgsql subtransactions
pr_description: Drop the `current_resource_owner`/`set_current_resource_owner` seams and the explicit `oldowner` save-and-restore dance in `exec_stmt_block_with_exceptions`, letting the subtransaction begin/release/rollback calls manage `CurrentResourceOwner` on their own. Removes the corresponding seam registrations in the handler crate's `init_seams`, shrinking the surface between the plpgsql executor and the resowner internals.
